mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 36 degrees with clear skies at Verona City Hall. Also, the ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city is working on the Military Ridge State Trail paving project to improve accessibility, with a public meeting scheduled for December 8. Additionally, the municipal court wants to clarify that while many traffic tickets can be paid online or by phone, those with O W I tickets must schedule an appointment with the city attorney.

There is plenty to do in our area, starting with yoga sessions today. Looking ahead, ART House 360 hosts events this Thursday, Hop Haus Brewing has trivia this Thursday, and the high school is hosting a music tribute to John Denver this Saturday.
In our weekly look at police activity, on October 23, an officer stopped two 13-year-olds on eMotos, leading to their parents receiving citations for allowing the prohibited use of the devices.
The delicious flavor of the day today is Devil's Food Cake. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, and we hope you can stop by to grab a scoop.
